name: Static
summary: A teen genius who is part superhero, part walking power grid. Virgil Hawkins, from Milestone Comics, gained electromagnetic powers in a gang fight gone wrong and became Static.
origin: Static is a nerdy, wisecracking teenager from Dakota who happens to be made of electricity, and he is the closest thing DC has to a young Peter Parker, in the best way. He came from Milestone Media, the company founded by Dwayne McDuffie, Denys Cowan, Michael Davis, Derek T. Dingle and Christopher Priest to put more diverse heroes on the stands. After a short preview in Icon #1 in 1993, he got his full debut in Static #1 by McDuffie, Robert L. Washington III and John Paul Leon. Virgil Hawkins was caught in the Big Bang, a gang war doused with experimental gas, and came out able to create and control electromagnetic energy. The Static Shock cartoon later made him a TV star.
powers: Flies on metal discs, like a manhole cover

storyline.title: Milestone's teen hero
storyline.beat: Virgil Hawkins, a teenager in the city of Dakota, gains electromagnetic powers when a gang war turns into the Big Bang, which mutates many of the people there. He is a flagship hero for the new Milestone Media.

storyline.title: TV star
storyline.beat: The Static Shock animated series becomes a hit, introducing Virgil to millions of young viewers.

storyline.title: Merged universe
storyline.beat: Milestone's heroes are folded into the main DC universe, and Static joins the Teen Titans.

storyline.title: Season One
storyline.beat: Milestone relaunches with Static: Season One, retelling his origin for a new era.

gossip.truth: He was created at Milestone Media, a Black-led company that published through DC before its heroes joined DC's universe.

gossip.text: His powers come from the Big Bang, a gang fight in Dakota where an experimental gas mutated people.
Co-creator Dwayne McDuffie later became a key writer and producer on Justice League Unlimited.
He can fly by riding metal objects, like a manhole cover, with magnetism.

quiz.q: What event gave Static his powers?

theme.tagline: High school nerd with a high-voltage side gig.

timeline.title: A preview in Icon
timeline.note: Milestone's Icon #1 gives a short sneak peek at Dakota teen Virgil Hawkins ahead of his own book.

timeline.title: Static #1
timeline.note: His solo series launches as a gang-war gas exposure gives Virgil electromagnetic powers.

timeline.title: Static Shock
timeline.note: The Static Shock cartoon makes Virgil a kids' TV star while tackling real-world teen issues.

timeline.title: Joins the Teen Titans
timeline.note: Static enters the main DC universe and joins the Teen Titans.

timeline.title: New 52 relaunch
timeline.note: Static Shock #1 relaunches Virgil with a new look as part of the New 52.

timeline.title: Milestone Returns
timeline.note: Milestone relaunches with a new Static Shock series, reintroducing Virgil for a new generation.
